source: User-provided installed Friday Night Funkin v0.8.6

MOM_CAR.note: Original artwork and within-animation motion preserved. Native root symbol translations and a per-pose canonical feet baseline correction are baked into frameXY for the browser renderer. Do not apply metadata offsets again.
MOM_CAR.normalAnimationPrefixRule: Use prefix + 0 for ordinary directions to exclude the miss suffix group.

GF_CAR.normalAnimationPrefixRule: Use prefix + 0 for ordinary directions to exclude the miss suffix group.

firstDeath.note: Native separate death/fakeout asset; reuse current BF death implementation or its original source.

deathLoop.note: Native separate death/fakeout asset; reuse current BF death implementation or its original source.

deathConfirm.note: Native separate death/fakeout asset; reuse current BF death implementation or its original source.

fakeoutDeath.note: Native separate death/fakeout asset; reuse current BF death implementation or its original source.

BF_CAR.normalAnimationPrefixRule: Use prefix + 0 for ordinary directions to exclude the miss suffix group.

GF_EXTENDED.normalAnimationPrefixRule: Use prefix + 0 for ordinary directions to exclude the miss suffix group.
compatibilityNotes: Native metadata drop70 requests indices0–12, while the root Crying label spans12frames. A repeated final texture was added as index12 so all declared indices are safe; original12frames are unchanged.

NENE_EXTENDED.normalAnimationPrefixRule: Use prefix + 0 for ordinary directions to exclude the miss suffix group.

PICO_CENSOR.note: Use only for a player note with kind censor. Reuses base PICO actor anchor; per-animation native Sparrow offsets are baked. Original voice stems already include the song audio.

PICO_OPPONENT.note: Opponent uses the same basic textures already present in PICO; use the native left/right remap and stage-side orientation.

PICO.note: Opponent uses the same basic textures already present in PICO; use the native left/right remap and stage-side orientation.

limitations: Stage shader uniforms, procedural train/car/mist/window motion and the optional doppelganger cutscene require runtime implementation; native metadata/scripts and all relevant packed art/audio are included.
Pico opponent reuses existing PICO art; apply native left/right label map from reuse metadata.
Packed cutscene timeline stores affine transforms and bitmap source rectangles; it does not bake stage-wide AdjustColorShader into textures.
Per-instance Animate color transforms are not applied by the generic raster extraction; original texture colors, geometry and alpha are retained.
Mom Car includes all native symbols and hold frames, using native root timeline translations for reliable shared geometry; do not additionally apply native metadata per-symbol offsets.

Native BF death/fakeout source is present as compact texture and draw-command timelines. Runtime may reuse existing BF death behavior or add these sequences; extraction itself does not change gameplay.

cutsceneBehavior.onlyWhen: Pico playable on phillyTrainErect, before first countdown, except chart editor playtest
cutsceneBehavior.notes: All eight actor branches and pool timeline are present. Runtime needs original timer/skip sequence and character visibility transitions; extraction does not implement the cutscene.

phillyTrainErect.player: BOYFRIEND or PICO according to song metadata
phillyTrainErect.partner: GF_EXTENDED or NENE_EXTENDED according to song metadata
